title: Workload Assessment & Meeting-Free Time Blocks
summary: Establish weekly focus windows without non-urgent admin meetings. Re-evaluate duty distribution using transparent capacity mapping.
actionable_steps: Define 2 dedicated blocks weekly reserved exclusively for lesson prep without staff meetings.
Conduct a monthly review of non-teaching administrative burdens.

source: OECD Wellbeing Framework - Work-Life Balance Guidelines
title: Digital Communication Boundaries Protocol
summary: Implement school-wide 'right to disconnect' guidelines restricting work emails and chat messaging past 18:00 on school evenings.
actionable_steps: Set automated response templates for non-urgent parent communications after school hours.
Agree on emergency-only contact channels for leadership.

title: Structured Leadership 1-on-1 Check-ins
summary: Provide regular non-evaluative support sessions focusing on teacher psychological safety and resource obstacles rather than performance audits.
actionable_steps: Schedule bi-weekly 20-minute empathetic check-in sessions with department heads.
Track operational friction points raised by teachers in an open feedback log.

title: Transparent Resource Allocation & Decision Clarity
summary: Publish criteria for classroom budget allocations and invite teacher representation on resource planning committees.
actionable_steps: Form a joint teacher-admin resource advisory group.
Provide written rationales for key administrative decisions affecting classroom teaching.

title: Blameless Retrospectives & Incident Reviews
summary: Adopt psychological safety frameworks for analyzing pedagogical challenges or disciplinary issues without individual blame.
actionable_steps: Replace punitive error reviews with structured 'lessons learned' peer discussions.
Encourage leadership to share vulnerability and past mistakes in staff meetings.

source: OECD TALIS Recommendations on Trust in Schools
title: Anonymous Feedback Channels & Action Commitments
summary: Establish safe continuous feedback loops where staff can express concerns without fear of reprisal, paired with visible management action.
actionable_steps: Maintain a monthly digital suggestion box reviewed publicly in staff meetings.
Publish leadership action plans responding to top staff concerns within 14 days.

title: Structured Peer Co-Working & Mentorship Circles
summary: Facilitate collaborative lesson planning triads to foster professional solidarity and reduce teacher isolation.
actionable_steps: Form cross-subject peer trios for shared curriculum design.
Allocate 1 hour monthly for informal peer wisdom sharing.

title: Teacher-Led Professional Learning Communities (PLCs)
summary: Empower teachers to direct their own professional development budgets towards action research and peer observation.
actionable_steps: Allocate dedicated micro-grants for teacher-led classroom research.
Facilitate voluntary peer classroom visits with structured observation rubrics.

source: ISO 45003:2021 guidance on role clarity and organizational change
title: Role Clarity & Change Communication Protocol
summary: Publish stable role expectations and communicate upcoming operational changes early enough for staff to plan and ask questions.
actionable_steps: Maintain a single written source for current responsibilities and decision owners.
Announce material schedule or policy changes with a clear rationale and transition window.

source: OECD TALIS guidance on teacher agency and participation
title: Teacher Voice & Safe Feedback Forum
summary: Create recurring channels where teachers can raise ideas, concerns, and dissenting perspectives without fear of retaliation.
actionable_steps: Reserve a structured teacher-led agenda slot in monthly staff meetings.
Offer an anonymous feedback channel and publish leadership responses to recurring themes.

source: OECD teacher wellbeing guidance on purpose and professional agency
title: Purpose Alignment & Impact Reflection
summary: Reconnect daily responsibilities with visible student and community outcomes while reducing tasks that staff experience as disconnected from educational purpose.
actionable_steps: Open quarterly planning with short examples of meaningful student or community impact.
Review recurring administrative tasks and remove or simplify work with no clear educational value.
